name: Nexadata
description: Nexadata is an agentic AI platform for enterprise data integration, the missing layer between source data and target analytics & planning platforms. The MCP server lets Claude connect to a Nexadata environment to discover workflows and pipelines, build and run data integration jobs, inspect run history and execution statistics, and pass runtime variables, all through conversation. Claude handles the reasoning while Nexadata executes deterministically, so raw customer data never leaves the platform. Turn business questions into trusted, validated data outputs without writing code or waiting on engineering.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nexadata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nexadata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.nexadata.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nexadata MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nexadata lists 50 MCP tools, including add_dataset_to_workflow, all_workflow_executions, create_default_output, create_output_pipeline, create_supporting_pipeline, create_workflow, delete_transformation, delete_variable, execute_workflow, fetch_pipeline_run_statistics, fetch_workflow_run_statistics, and get_mapping_group_edit_attribution.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nexadata?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Nexadata in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Nexadata requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nexadata is developed by Nexadata, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
